summary: Frontend-only mandatory retest completed on public preview after single-handler Nav change. Pointer navigation remains flaky/non-deterministic across required menu links, quick open-click still fails, while keyboard Enter/Space and timeline lock behavior pass. No page error selectors and no horizontal overflow detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Still inconsistent. Across reruns: Legacy failed 3/3, Tracks failed 3/3, Cars failed 1/3, Victories failed 1/3; Timeline passed 3/3.
Open menu then immediate Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN (active-node-0).
Mostly improved in one session, but Legacy still failed (stayed active-node-0) while Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories passed.

integration_issues.issue: Behavior indicates timing/race condition remains; same selectors pass/fail across fresh runs without code changes, especially under quick interaction.

action_items: Stabilize pointer routing for all five mandatory links in fresh sessions (especially Legacy and Tracks).
Fix quick open-click path so first immediate pointer click dispatches deterministic spatial routing.
Add deterministic route completion signal/guard (or awaitable navigation state) before closing menu to avoid timing race.
After fix, rerun mandatory matrix: fresh five links, sequential five links, quick open-click, keyboard Enter/Space, timeline lock through menu, and gallery/quote/victory regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav now uses single onClick, but race persists; setTimeout(0) menu-close can still compete with route dispatch/readiness under fast pointer interactions.
SpatialExperience computes target top from dynamic runway dimensions; early interactions likely occur before stable layout/scroll range, contributing to inconsistent node landings.
Route state validation currently relies on nearest-stop active-node; small under-scroll can still report ORIGIN, masking partial navigation and exposing precision/timing issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed mandatory retest on https://ui-revamp-dynamics.preview.emergentagent.com. PASS: Keyboard Enter/Space, Home Origin, timeline route+lock+ArrowRight year change, no .error selectors, no horizontal overflow. FAIL: Fresh matrix remains flaky (legacy 0/3, tracks 0/3), quick open-click fails, sequential legacy still fails. Additional regression checks for gallery/quote/victories via this run were inconclusive due route instability and should be revalidated after nav stability fix.
rca of the issue: Repro: 1) Reload, open menu, click Legacy/Tracks (and sometimes Cars/Victories) -> active node remains 0. 2) Repeat in fresh reloads; pass/fail changes per run. 3) Quick open->Timeline click fails consistently. Likely root cause is unresolved interaction timing race between menu state transition/close and spatial route execution/readiness/layout stabilization. Mitigation: enforce a single deterministic route transaction with explicit completion/ack before menu close, and gate pointer routing until runway metrics/router are fully ready.
